findings.text: non-blocking: the done_when requires the test files importing the changed modules to add no failure against base in matched all_debug arms, but the recorded arms run only tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, neither of which imports reckon/_worker_fence.py, reckon/nested_launch.py or reckon/crew/reports.py, so the 58-to-60 pair cannot see a regression in the changed modules; the direct importer tests/test_nested_launch.py is in no arm and its base/head parity is asserted at manifest.md:21 with no log path under the run directory.

non-blocking: RECKON_SHIM_HOME is set with --setenv on the whole fenced argv (reckon/_worker_fence.py:2304-2306) and read unconditionally by srun and salloc too, so any shim resolved inside that fence from a different checkout takes repo_root from the fence composer's checkout and imports its reckon.nested_launch rather than its own; the launcher strips other checkouts' shim directories from the worker PATH (reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:790-796), so the route needs a gate that prepends its own tree's host_shims inside the fence.

non-blocking: the recipe's limit names only "a scheduler binary resolved only on the job node's own path" as unguarded, but _scheduler_search_directories at :1969 reads only the composing process's PATH while the launch appends declared backend directories to the worker's PATH (reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:799), so a real scheduler copy in such a directory is also unmasked on the submitting node and the recorded limit understates the residual the docstring at :1973 states.

non-blocking: scheduler_shields' search_path parameter has no caller — its only call at reckon/_worker_fence.py:2295 passes relay_root alone and the new test does not call it — so the argument is an unexercised branch rather than a used seam.
